caveat_sup12: Not medical advice; check with a physician/pharmacist if pregnant, breastfeeding, under 18, or taking medication or having heart, kidney, liver, thyroid or psychiatric conditions.
Prefer third-party-tested products (Informed Sport, NSF Certified for Sport, Kölner Liste); contamination with prohibited substances is a known risk.
Legal status differs by country (melatonin, high-dose caffeine products, some stimulants); the app shows a country note when a locale is set.
Supplements are optional; the ranked order of impact is: total protein, calories, sleep, training consistency, then creatine and caffeine.
priority_order: total protein, calories, sleep, training consistency, then creatine and caffeine

entries.name: Creatine monohydrate
entries.dose: 3-5 g/day (about 0.1 g/kg/day); optional loading 20 g/day (4 x 5 g) for 5-7 days
notes: Expect +1-2 kg water weight in the first weeks (NUT-15).
Do not recommend with kidney disease or a single kidney: refer.

entries.name: Caffeine
entries.dose: 3-6 mg/kg (start 2-3 mg/kg); no benefit above 9 mg/kg; daily total <= 400 mg
entries.timing: 60 min before the session; cut-off bedtime - 9 h (<= 100 mg) / bedtime - 13 h (>= 200 mg)
notes: Response varies with genetics and habitual intake.
The 400 mg/day EFSA guidance value was not fetched live (R3 §12.7).

entries.name: Protein powder (whey / casein / plant blends)
entries.dose: 20-40 g servings to close the gap to NUT-01
entries.timing: when whole food is impractical (travel days)
notes: Plant proteins: use blends or a larger serving to reach about 2.5-3 g leucine.

entries.name: Vitamin D (conditional)
entries.dose: 1,000-2,000 IU/day only when measured low or >= 2 risk factors; upper limit 4,000 IU/day without supervision
notes: Routine testing and empiric supplementation above the DRI are not recommended in healthy adults < 75 (Demay 2024).
Risk factors: little sun / indoor work, latitude > 40° in winter, darker skin, covering clothing, BMI > 30.

entries.name: Electrolytes (conditional)
entries.dose: sodium 300-600 mg per hour of exercise in fluid
entries.timing: only for sessions > 1-2 h, heat, or sweat loss > 1 L/h

entries.name: Beta-alanine
entries.dose: 4-6 g/day for >= 2-4 weeks, split doses <= 1.6 g
notes: Benefits 1-4 min efforts (intervals, high-rep sets); minimal relevance to heavy lifting.

entries.name: Citrulline malate
notes: Small increase in repetitions to failure (ES about 0.20).

entries.name: Melatonin (travel / jet lag)
entries.timing: 30 min to 3 h before the desired bedtime; time-zone shifts / hotel nights only
notes: Reduces sleep-onset latency by about 7 min.
entries.legal_note: prescription-only in several EU countries at ≥ 2 mg — check local rules; not verified live (R3 §12.13)

entries.name: Omega-3 (EPA+DHA)
entries.timing: daily, only when fish intake < 2 servings/week
notes: No support for lean mass, strength or function in healthy adults; general-health rationale only.

entries.name: Multivitamin
entries.timing: only during energy restriction or restricted diets (vegan, travel with poor food access)

entries.name: BCAA (alone)
entries.do_not_reason: Cannot stimulate MPS without the other EAAs; redundant when protein target is met

entries.name: HMB (trained adults)
entries.do_not_reason: No meaningful effect on lean mass, fat mass or strength in trained young adults

entries.name: Glutamine
entries.citation: Kerksick 2018 ("little to no evidence" category — table not verified live)
entries.do_not_reason: No hypertrophy/strength effect in healthy people

entries.name: "Testosterone boosters" (tribulus, fenugreek blends, D-aspartic acid)
entries.do_not_reason: Ingredients mostly unstudied or ineffective; some reduce testosterone; doses above tolerable limits

entries.name: Stimulant "fat burners", DMAA/DMHA, ephedra, high-dose yohimbine
entries.citation: Maughan 2018 IOC; regulatory actions — not fetched

entries.name: Arginine, ornithine, CLA, D-ribose, chromium, "detox"/"cleanse", collagen for muscle, raspberry ketones, "test/estrogen blockers"
High-dose vitamin D without a blood test
entries.do_not_reason: No benefit if replete; toxicity risk
